verdict.rationale: Runpod documents an S3-protocol compatible API for direct network-volume access without launching a Pod, plus runpodctl CLI for transferring files between local system and Runpod, alongside SSH/web-proxy access and network volumes for persistent cross-resource storage. Community evidence corroborates the S3-like ecosystem usage pattern (templates, GPU access) though doesn't specifically stress-test the S3 API. missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of the S3-compatible endpoint performance and reliability, and explicit cloud-storage sync (e.g., S3/GCS bucket sync) beyond the network-volume API.
